quizName:
Hardest Questions in Georgia
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic will soon combine into one lane.

questions.question: You see pedestrians near the road. What should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn and keep your speed.
Speed up to leave the area quickly.

questions.explanation: Watch for pedestrians who may cross your path. If you see pedestrians near the road, slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction where this sign is posted.

questions.question: If you become tired while driving, what should you do?

options.text: Stop to rest or let someone else drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to rest or let someone else drive.
questions.explanation: Tiredness slows your thinking and reactions, which makes driving unsafe. Stop to rest or change drivers.

questions.question: How can you identify an aggressive driver?

options.text: They make sudden and improper lane changes.
The number of passengers in their car.

questions.correctAnswerText: They make sudden and improper lane changes.
questions.explanation: Watch other drivers around you. If a driver makes sudden or improper lane changes, do not challenge them. The safest thing to do is stay away from them.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a steep hill. Slow down and adjust your speed to avoid crashes and brake damage.

questions.question: What does excessive speed do?

options.text: Saves time and gets you to your destination faster.
Increases the risk of serious injury and death.

questions.correctAnswerText: Increases the risk of serious injury and death.
questions.explanation: Excessive speed is a major cause of car crashes. It does not save time and leads to poor decisions.

questions.question: Fatigue increases the risk of:
questions.explanation: Fatigue causes errors with speed and distance, slows your decisions, and can make you fall asleep behind the wheel. This can cause crashes that injure or kill you or others.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: A round sign warns you of a railroad crossing ahead. It is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. You should slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: "No passing zone" signs tell drivers:

options.text: That it is not safe to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: That it is not safe to pass.
questions.explanation: A "No passing zone" sign means you cannot pass other vehicles in that area. These signs are placed where it is unsafe to pass because you cannot see far enough ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign shows parking spaces reserved for people with disabilities. Only vehicles with disability license plates or parking placards may use these spaces.

questions.question: If you are getting tired while driving, you should:

options.text: Stop and either get rest or change drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and either get rest or change drivers.
questions.explanation: To avoid driving while tired, take breaks every hour on long trips. If possible, share driving with another person so each of you can rest while the other drives.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction shown by the arrow. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This sign indicates a:
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about upcoming hazards. Round signs are used only to warn about railroad crossings ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted where you are not allowed to enter. You may see it on one-way streets or if you try to enter an expressway ramp going the wrong direction.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming up ahead.

questions.question: If a truck or bus is making a right turn where you also need to make a right turn, you should:

options.text: Quickly turn before the truck or bus is able to.
Wait until the truck or bus turns before you turn.
Squeeze between the truck or bus and the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the truck or bus turns before you turn.
questions.explanation: Do not try to squeeze your car between a turning truck or bus and the curb. This can cause a serious crash. Wait until the truck or bus has finished turning before you turn.

questions.question: If you see animals standing near the roadway while driving, you should:

options.text: Speed up to scare them away.
Slow down and proceed with caution.
Quickly swerve into the next lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: Slow down and be careful if you see animals near the road. They may suddenly move into traffic. Some animals travel in groups, so there may be more animals you cannot see that are also near the road.

questions.question: When driving in work zones, you should:

options.text: Follow the driver in front of you closely.
Pass the driver in front of you as soon as you can.
Stay a safe distance behind other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay a safe distance behind other vehicles.
questions.explanation: In work zones, keep a safe distance between your vehicle and barriers, trucks, equipment, workers, and other vehicles. Do not follow too closely.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: No left turn is allowed here.
You can turn left only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn is allowed here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits left turns.

questions.question: If your vehicle has a two-part safety belt system, you should:

options.text: Use both the lap and shoulder belts.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use both the lap and shoulder belts.
questions.explanation: Always wear both the lap belt and shoulder belt. Using only one part does not protect you well. Even with an automatic shoulder belt, fasten your lap belt too.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers. This sign alerts you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: If you encounter an aggressive driver, you should:
questions.explanation: The safest choice is to get out of an aggressive driver's way. Do not compete with other drivers. Follow road rules and respect all drivers.

questions.question: A steady green traffic light at an intersection means:

options.text: You may proceed through the intersection at a safe speed if it is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may proceed through the intersection at a safe speed if it is clear.
questions.explanation: A steady green light means you can go. Yield to any traffic or pedestrians already in the intersection, then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: If the roadway is wet or icy, you should:
questions.explanation: Wet, snowy, or icy roads reduce tire grip. Slow down when roads are wet or icy.

questions.question: If a motorist sees pedestrians in an upcoming crosswalk, what should the motorist do?

options.text: Continue ahead. The motorist has the right-of-way.
Wait for the pedestrians to cross the street.
Pull to the right and go around the pedestrians.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for the pedestrians to cross the street.
questions.explanation: Drivers must let pedestrians cross in a crosswalk. Wait until the intersection is clear before proceeding.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves.

questions.question: Which of the following substances can affect the ability to drive?

options.text: Cough syrups and cold tablets containing codeine or antihistamines.

questions.explanation: Many drugs impair driving. These include tranquilizers, sedatives, marijuana, and over-the-counter medicines like cough syrup, cold tablets, and allergy medicine.

questions.question: If you have had several beers, alcohol's effects will only go away by:
questions.explanation: Only time removes alcohol from your body. Coffee, exercise, or cold showers do not speed this up. Your body needs about one hour to process one drink.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means "stop."

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign alerts you that roadwork is coming up. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices when driving through a work zone.

questions.question: When a person using a white cane or guide dog is crossing the street, you should:

options.text: Stop until the person is well away from your path of travel.
Honk your horn as you proceed past them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop until the person is well away from your path of travel.
questions.explanation: You must stop and let blind pedestrians cross safely. Always give them the right-of-way.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic will merge into your lane from the right. Be prepared to let them merge safely.

questions.question: If you become drowsy while driving, you should:
questions.explanation: Stop at a rest area or service station to take a nap, stretch, or switch drivers. Caffeine pills are not a safe substitute for rest.

questions.question: It is unlawful to:

options.text: Pass another vehicle in any marked no passing zone.
Pass another vehicle over a railroad crossing.

questions.explanation: You cannot pass in no passing zones, at street crossings, at railroad crossings, or where a solid yellow line marks your lane. Do not pass in work zones or when the car ahead stopped for a pedestrian.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and dangerous. This sign warns you to slow down because your car will take longer to stop on wet pavement.
